## Description (paste as plain text)

Ring in the new year with an invitation your guests will love opening. A champagne bottle appears on their phone: one tap and the cork pops with bubbles, the card appears and fireworks light up the screen. Pick one of 5 themes, edit it in minutes with no code, and share one link by WhatsApp, text or email.

✨ WHAT YOUR GUESTS SEE
• A champagne bottle with a "You're Invited" label. One tap pops the cork
• Champagne bubbles, then the card appears with fireworks
• A garland of stars and mini disco balls, and falling gold confetti
• "NEW YEAR'S EVE Party" in big capitals and elegant script, with the new year added automatically
• A fireworks illustration with the year, or your own photo
• A live countdown to the party
• Date, time and address, with one-tap Google Maps directions
• Add to calendar (Apple, Google, Outlook)
• Dress code with colour suggestions and an optional sticker (for example "Masks required!")
• Schedule, menu, "At Midnight" toast details, "Good to Know" notes and a closing message (turn any section on or off)
• Built-in RSVP: guests choose yes or no, the number of guests, any allergies, and a song request for the DJ
• Tap the champagne glasses for extra fireworks
• Optional music: Auld Lang Syne music box, or your own MP3. It only plays when a guest taps the music button

🥂 5 THEMES INCLUDED
• Midnight Blue: deep navy, gold stars and confetti
• Champagne Blush: blush pink, rose gold and bubbles
• Disco Night: retro disco lettering and rainbow lights
• Neon Glow: glowing pink and electric blue on deep purple
• Emerald Gatsby: emerald green, gold and art deco lines
Switch theme with one click, as often as you like.

🎉 FOR ANY NEW YEAR CELEBRATION
The wording is written for you: New Year's Eve Party, Countdown Party, New Year's Eve Dinner, Cocktail Party, Office New Year Party or New Year's Day Brunch. You can also change every word yourself.

📩 RSVPS STRAIGHT TO YOUR PHONE
Choose how replies reach you:
• WhatsApp: the guest's reply opens as a ready-to-send message to your number
• Email: the reply opens as a ready-to-send email to you
• Your own form link (for example a Google Form)
No account, no app and no monthly fees.

🖥 SO EASY TO EDIT
Open the editor in your browser and fill in a simple form. The invitation updates live as you type. Add your own photo, change every word, and save your draft to come back later. No coding and nothing to install.

✅ HOW IT WORKS
1. Purchase and download the files
2. Open the editor on a computer and fill in your details
3. Download your finished invitation
4. Publish it with Canva (step-by-step guide included) to get your link
5. Share your link by WhatsApp, text message or email

📦 WHAT YOU GET
• Easy editor (editor.html)
• Invitation template with all 5 themes (index.html)
• Step-by-step PDF guide

⚠️ PLEASE NOTE
• This is a digital download. No physical item will be shipped.
• Use a computer (laptop or desktop) to edit. Guests can open the invitation on any phone or computer.
• You need a Canva account to publish your invitation.
• RSVPs arrive by WhatsApp, email or your own form. There is no guest list dashboard.
• The bottle, fireworks and decorations are illustrations, not photos. You can add your own photo.
• For personal use. Please do not resell or share the files.
• I created this invitation and its editor with the help of AI tools.
• Because this is a digital product, returns are not accepted. If anything is unclear, send me a message and I'll gladly help.

Happy New Year! 🥂
